doc.title: Anne Phillips interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, February 24, 2025

title: First New York apartment and rent
summary: Her first apartment cost fifty dollars each for three; she has lived in her current place since 1977.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What did — this is kind of a silly question, but do you remember what you paid for your first residence, your first apartment in New York City?
Yeah I think three of us paid 50 bucks apiece, and it was a two bedroom apartment on the fifth floor. Yeah.

Where I live now I rented in 1977. And it went condo. And I couldn’t buy it then although it was about a quarter or less of what they — it’s like a 3 million dollar apartment, so I’m still living here.
